# `oaap cohort`

a training landscape from one template (RFC-0046): create, add, reset, list, stop, start, material, handout, export, remove, secret, sweep, extend, standby-after.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap cohort {create,add,reset,list,stop,start,material,handout,export,remove,secret,sweep,extend,standby-after} [target] [second] [third] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `target` | create: the template directory; otherwise the cohort (material: `update`; secret: set\|list\|remove) |
| `second` | material update: the cohort; export: the target directory; secret: the name |
| `third` | material update: the directory |
| `--tenant TENANT` | tenant label (default: the template's own, or the node's default tenant) |
| `--seat SEAT` | add/reset/remove: one seat |
| `--name WHO` | add: a named participant |
| `--keep-home` | reset: rebuild from the template, keep the files |
| `--purge` | remove: delete the storage with the instances |
| `--users` | remove: delete the users as well |
| `--yes` | carry it out after reading what is deleted |
| `--handout-file HANDOUT_FILE` | create/add: where the one-time list goes (default: the template's `handout` name in the current directory -- never inside the template) |
| `--confirm-source CONFIRM_SOURCE` | install from this unverified store source |
| `--stdin` | secret set: read the value from standard input |
| `--dry-run` | create, sweep, extend: say what would happen, change nothing |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `create` | yes |
| `add` | yes |
| `reset` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
| `stop` | yes |
| `start` | yes |
| `material` | yes |
| `handout` | yes |
| `export` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `secret` | yes |
| `sweep` | yes |
| `extend` | yes |
| `standby-after` | yes |
